Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"vlm\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"vlm_config\":{\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\",\"temperature\":0.0}}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
